title: platform-standup-2026-04-06
content:
Date: 2026-04-06
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Maya, Lucas, Hannah, Aaron (SRE oncall)

TL;DR
- Control plane rollout candidate for v1.3 submitted; smoke tests mostly green but one regression in route reconciliation under high fan-out.
- Routing: policy rollout delayed due to reconciliation issue (ROUTE-101). Working on mitigation to reduce flapping.
- Auth: quota enforcement bug reproduced (AUTH-322). Hotfix branch open, planning deploy tomorrow morning.
- Quotas: saw a quota accounting drift for reserved capacity customers — investigation ongoing (PLAT-789).

Updates by area
1) Control Plane- Owner: Priya
- What went well: v1.3 candidate includes improved leader election fallback logic and faster route reconciliation in normal loads.
- Current work: running extended soak test (48h) on staging; found ~3% increase in reconciliation latency under synthetic high-fanout (50k routes) workloads.
- Risk: latency spike causes transient mis-routes when combined with routing-policy backoffs.
- Action: Ethan to add additional instrumentation around route diff batching and push patch to reduce per-iteration work (PR #456).
- Blocker: need a reproducible load generator for cross-DC routing; Lucas to follow up with SRE for a synthetic traffic harness.

2) Routing- Owner: Ethan
- Issue: ROUTE-101: policy reconciliation can cause route flapping when a fallback policy triggers and then multiple compatible variants unregister/register. Root cause appears to be race between cache invalidation and KV write propagation.- Mitigation in flight: introduce short jitter + rate limiter on policy updates to reduce simultaneous churn.
- Short term: enable conservative fallback policy by default for Dedicated tier to reduce impact while we fix reconciliation.
- Note: This will be a config change, no model changes. Maya to update docs and Console UI flag for canary cohorts.

3) Auth- Owner: Maya
- Incident summary: AUTH-322 reproduced — quota enforcement IPC race allows ~0.5% requests to bypass quotas under heavy parallel token refresh.
- Status: reproducer and unit tests added. Hotfix branch auth/quota-fix-hotfix created.
- Plan: staged deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT, rollback plan in place. Hannah to run pre-deploy smoke tests and sequence of quota verification scenarios.
- Linked: AUTH-322, unit tests in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth/pull/78

4) Quotas & Billing- Owner: Lucas
- Observation: billing reconciliation job showed drift for reserved capacity customers; small undercounting of usage for batch-prefetch flows. Triage shows mismatch in window boundaries between serving runtime and billing aggregator (timezone + DST edge-case?).
- Next steps: Lucas to file PLAT-789 epic with timeline; temporary fix: align aggregator window to UTC and run backfill for affected customers.
- Customer impact: notifying CS for customers A and B (internal ticket: CS-4123).

Incidents / Oncall- Owner: Aaron (SRE)
- No Sev1s this week. Minor ticket: intermittent increase in 99th latency for the console when datacenter X experienced partial network congestion — traced to retry amplification.
- Oncall note: ensure circuit breakers for control-plane -> console calls are tuned (Aaron to push change).

Decisions made
- Canary cohort for v1.3 will be 5% traffic for 24h with auto-rollback threshold of >1.5% error increase and >30% increase in reconciliation latency.
- Conservative fallback policy enabled for Dedicated tier until ROUTE-101 is fixed.

Action items (owners + due dates)
- Ethan: push route diff batching patch and perf test results (due 2026-04-07).
- Lucas: create PLAT-789 epic with backfill plan + coordinate CS notices (due 2026-04-08).
- Maya: prepare auth hotfix rollout runbook and Console toggle update (due 2026-04-06 EOD).
- Hannah: run pre-deploy smoke tests for auth hotfix and validate quota enforcement scenarios (deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT) (due 2026-04-07 08:30 PT).
- Priya: schedule cross-team sync with SRE and serving-runtime to validate reconciliation harness (meeting by 2026-04-09).

Notes / open questions
- Should we temporarily throttle control-plane write QPS from the Console to reduce reconciliation load? Pros: immediate reduction in churn. Cons: may slow down important operator actions. Priya to list impacted flows.
- Need a better observability dashboard for policy update churn (Maya to prototype queries for the Console metrics page).

Meeting adjourned. Next standup: 2026-04-08 (Wednesday) 09:30 PT

Quick links and references
- PLAT-789: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-789
- ROUTE-101: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ROUTE-101
- AUTH-322: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AUTH-322
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/456, https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth/pull/78

Notes-to-self (informal)
- REMEMBER: Follow up with finance on how the backfill will be billed to affected customers (convo with Mei from Billing).
- TODO: add small workload generator to infra repo and tag SRE for help.
